content.mainText: ContactLet's Talk About Safer Workplaces, Better EHS Systems or Stronger Communication.I'm open to Occupational Safety & Health opportunities, EHS system projects, workplace safety collaboration, digital communication work and professional networking.Emailhello@cynthiamueni.comPhone+254 748 810 670LocationNairobi, KenyaBusiness HoursMonday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PMSaturday: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PMTypical response: I aim to respond to professional enquiries within 24 hours.Let's Connect AboutOccupational Safety & HealthEHS SystemsDigital CommunicationProfessional CollaborationLeave this field emptyName *Email *OrganisationPhoneEnquiry Type *Select an enquiry typeOccupational Safety & HealthEHS SystemsDigital CommunicationProfessional OpportunityCollaborationOtherSubject *Message *Send MessageConnect ProfessionallyFollow along or reach out directly on LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Facebook, or GitHub.LinkedInWhatsAppFacebookGitHubQuestionsBefore You Reach OutWhat types of opportunities can I contact you about?Occupational Safety & Health, EHS Systems, Digital Communication, professional opportunities and collaboration. Feel free to reach out about any of these.Do you work outside Nairobi?Yes. I can support opportunities in Nairobi, across Kenya, and remote work where appropriate.How quickly can I expect a response?I aim to respond to professional enquiries within approximately 24 hours.Can I discuss an EHS system idea with you?Yes, I'm glad to discuss ideas around workplace inspections, hazard reporting, corrective actions, risk management and related EHS processes. Some of these systems are still in development, so we'd be discussing direction and fit rather than a finished product.What if I need a website or general software solution?For general websites, web applications and non-EHS software solutions, visit HarunLucas Dev.Visit HarunLucas DevStart a Conversation That Leads to Better Workplaces.Whether it's workplace safety, an EHS system idea, digital communication work, or professional collaboration, I'd like to hear about it.Send a MessageView My Work
